text:
Mina: Quick mock + short Loom of the new preflight scan flow — focus on the network-debug snackbar we discussed. attaching in thread.
Marco: Saw it. Is the Undo CTA persistent or ephemeral? mock shows ~4s toast.
Mina: 4s for now. PM asked for 8s to cut down on support tickets.
Sam: 8s seems OK, but worried about overlap with autoscan retries — what if the retry UI fights the toast? maybe persist if 'Show logs' is open.
Riley: Accessibility nit: snackbar should use role=\"status\" and the primary link must be keyboard-focusable. Also current orange (WCAG) is ~3.2:1 — fails contrast for small text.
Marco: Can we try #b76a00 or #8a4f00? will run contrast tool. also we should avoid only color to indicate severity.
Mina: Also propose clearer copy: current 'Probe errored' -> 'Network probe failed — partial results available. Show logs · Undo' feels more actionable.
Sam: +1 for clearer copy. Also prefer 'Show logs' over 'View details' for discoverability.
Riley: 'Show logs' is better. Ensure dynamic aria-label like 'Show logs for host foo.example.com' so screen readers get context.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staged build uploaded: prereq-snackbar-a11y at 2324999900
Marco: I'll mock persistent snackbar state (dismiss, undo, show logs) and add keyboard nav tests. Will push PR with contrast update.
Mina: Thanks — @Riley can you do a quick a11y pass after PR lands?
Riley: Yup. Quick checklist: role=status, focusable link, aria-label with host id, contrast >=4.5 for small text, announcement suppression to avoid duplicate speaks.
Sam: :thumbsup: sounds good — let's aim to ship with dedicated toggles for persistence in the settings.
